source.clause: For every list of natural numbers, return its elements in nondecreasing order, preserving how many times each element occurs.

contract.name: Sorting.postcondition
contract.statement:
def postcondition (input output : List Nat) : Prop :=
  output.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ∧ output.Perm input ∧ output.length ≤ 10
